newsitem.title: PORTUGAL: INSTANT VIEW-Bank/Portugal cuts interest rates.
newsitem.headline: INSTANT VIEW-Bank/Portugal cuts interest rates.

text.p: The following are analysts' reactions to the rate cuts by the Bank of Portugal. The repo rate fell 20 basis points to 6.30 and the drain rate was cut 40 basis points to 5.80 percent.

"This is more or less within the expectations but I expected the cut in the repo rate to be between five and 10 basis points more. However, widening the spread between the repo and the drain rate gives more room for fresh cuts in the repo in the future."

"The cuts are positive for the share market because sooner or later they will force short-term (money) market rates to fall. It should have an impact on shares although today all eyes are on the United States because the indicators (there) were not very favourable."
RUI MARTINS DOS SANTOS, BANCO PORTUGUES DE INVESTIMENTO:

"It was expected in its timing and in its dimension. For the future, the Bank can still cut rates although it will probably opt for reducing the repo rate (cutting the spread with the drain rate). The next cut could be soon because the (year-on-year) inflation rate promises to go below two percent in the next couple of months which would be very positive and favour another cut."

"I expected a bigger cut in the repo rate taking into account the rate and inflation differentials with Spain. But the Bank of Portugal has never hurt the economy with its prudence. I think it will be very well received abroad and it will sustain belief that there is room for the escudo to appreciate further against the mark bearing in mind a cut of 30 basis points was discounted and it fell 20."
